artworks.title: Castleton, Vermont
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Mrs. Rudolf Eickemeyer, daughter of the artist, 1938)
artworks.description: The image depicts a rural landscape with a creek winding through grassy banks and shrubs. A tree and several buildings are scattered across the scene. The color palette is monochromatic, consisting of shades of grey.

artworks.title: Granby, Connecticut
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Mrs. Rudolf Eickemeyer, daughter of the artist, 1938)
artworks.description: The image displays a landscape with trees, a fence, and a house in the distance. The sky is visible low on the horizon, blending with the land in a monochromatic style. Trees are detailed with leaves and branches, casting shadows. A fence runs horizontally near the trees, indicating property division. A house with a chimney is seen in the distance to the right. The drawing is in shades of gray, creating a tranquil atmosphere with subtle contrast between the sky and foliage.

artworks.title: James McCullough's Leadmill
artworks.medium: graphite and gray ink wash with gouache on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, Membership Association Fund, 1948)
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with several buildings and trees on the horizon, a river or wide path flowing across the scene, and grass and foliage in the foreground. The composition features an expansive sky dominating most of the image. The artwork utilizes muted tones of gray and soft browns, with intricate details in pencil strokes to depict textures of vegetation and rocks.

artworks.title: Reclining Female Nude
artworks.medium: chalk and pastel on gray wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Mrs. William J. Glackens, wife of the artist, 1948)
artworks.description: The image shows a woman lying on her side, propped up on pillows. She is unclothed and has long hair styled back. Her facial features are softly defined with eyebrows and lips. She is wearing a bracelet on her wrist. The background consists of a draped sheet and a plain upper background.

artworks.title: Tree Trunks
artworks.medium: graphite with gouache on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, Membership Association Fund, 1949)
artworks.description: The image shows a large, old tree with gnarled and twisted branches extending into empty space. The horizon is not visible. The artist employed a style of sketching, with lines creating a textured depiction of the bark and branches. The background is unadorned, highlighting the tree. The color palette consists of brown and gray against a tan canvas. Twigs and branches extend around the tree, with shading enhancing the dimensionality.

artworks.title: Nude with Robe
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase through a gift of Robert M. McLane, 1977)
artworks.description: The image depicts a full-body line drawing of a standing person. The person is shown standing upright with a hand raised near their head. The person's facial features are minimalistic and their hair has a flower-like adornment. They are nude, with flowing lines suggesting draped cloth around their back and one shoulder. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Buildings by Moonlight
artworks.medium: black ink wash and watercolor on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Milch Galleries, 1949)
artworks.description: The image displays a landscape from an elevated point of view, focusing on a cluster of structures with an ancient or ruined appearance. The horizon is low, marked by jagged, rocky formations. The brushstrokes are loose and textured, with soft edges blending the elements. The color palette consists of muted earth tones—shades of gray, brown, and hints of yellow. In the distance, the land rises into dark, rolling hills or cliffs, with a reflective body of water adding depth to the composition.

artworks.title: Kauterskill Clove
artworks.medium: graphite with gouache on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase and exchange, 1977)
artworks.description: The drawing depicts a scene with a cluster of trees and foliage. The point of view is at eye level. There is no prominent horizon depicted. The style of the pencil work shows delicate and precise brushstrokes, capturing intricate details of the tree branches and leaves with varied line weights. The color palette is minimal, with soft gray pencil lines on a muted beige or off-white paper. Closest to us are two large trees with textured bark and intricate branches, surrounded by more trees and foliage fading into the background.

artworks.title: Clove Road, Catskills; Through the Clove—Catskills; and On the Road to Bracketts [recto]
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Kate Bunner, wife of the artist, 1902)
artworks.description: The image features three pencil sketches of rural landscapes. The first sketch shows a valley with a riverbed, trees, and rolling hills. The second sketch shows a cabin surrounded by trees and sloping hills. The third sketch depicts a country road with trees and a stone wall. The sketches have soft pencil strokes, creating texture and form with a monochromatic color palette emphasizing shading and light play.

artworks.title: View of the Second Falls on the Sawkill River
artworks.medium: watercolor with pen and black ink on wove paper mounted to wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Ted Cooper, 1981)
artworks.description: The image shows a small waterfall cascading down from an elevated perspective, with tall trees filling the background. The painting features delicate and precise brushstrokes, creating texture in the foliage and water. The color palette includes shades of green, brown, blue, and white. Two figures are seated on a rocky bank, partially hidden by bushes and shaded by trees, observing the scenery. The river winds through the landscape, blending into the distant treeline.

artworks.title: Trees in a Field
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a natural landscape viewed from eye level. The horizon is high in the composition, with trees stretching across the width of the image. The trees and shrubs extend into the distance, creating a sense of a continuous landscape. The brushstrokes are loose and sketchy, typical of a quick rendering with soft graphite or charcoal. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of gray on sepia-toned paper. Near the viewer, there is a patch of ground with rough, textural marks indicating grass and a shallow ditch, leading the eye into the landscape where the trees stand at the center.

artworks.title: Male Nude
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Mrs. Walter Shirlaw, wife of the artist, 1913)
artworks.description: The image depicts a sketch of a nude male figure in a pose. The man is leaning back slightly with his left arm extended upwards, appearing to hold onto a rod or pole. His right arm is bent with his hand resting on a rectangular object. His head is turned to the right, showing his profile. The man's facial features are detailed, with a strong jawline and a serious expression. His hair is styled to the side with a slightly wavy texture. The figure is unclothed, and there are no additional objects or adornments in the sketch. The background is plain, emphasizing the figure. The artist's signature, "W. Shirlaw Munich," is located in the lower left corner of the sketch.

artworks.title: Aŭf Staŭfá Brŭck
artworks.medium: etching in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Mr. S.R. Koehler, Boston, Massachusetts, 1881)
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with an elevated point of view. The horizon is high in the composition, featuring distant trees and possibly a church steeple. A cluster of buildings is visible on the horizon line. In the foreground, people are walking along a path flanked by trees and bushes. The style uses dark etching lines for contrast and texture. The color scheme is monochromatic, with the path leading towards the distant horizon.

artworks.title: Study for "Astronomy"
artworks.medium: charcoal with colored chalk on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of the American Academy of Arts and Letters, 1955)
artworks.description: The image shows a woman seated on a draped surface with her right leg bent, left foot on the ground. Her left arm rests on a globe, holding a pair of compasses. She is looking to her right, with a profile view, straight nose, prominent cheekbones, hair pulled back, partially covered by a headband. The woman is nude, draped in fabrics. To her right, there's a scroll with text and a stack of books, the top one labeled "ASTRONOMIA." The background is plain with a curved arch shape.

artworks.title: Castle on a River
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, William A. Clark Fund, 1965)
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape from a slightly elevated point of view, looking across towards water and hills in the distance. The horizon is positioned below the midpoint of the image, with a body of water meeting the base of large hills. To the right, a castle stands on a rocky outcrop. The brushstrokes provide a fluid quality to the landscape. The color palette is dominated by warm pinks, soft browns, and hints of pale blue. A small figure in a red garment and another sitting figure are on the grassy terrain. White sails are visible in the distance on the water.

artworks.title: Study of Hands Knitting [recto]
artworks.medium: graphite on gray laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of J. William Middendorf, II, 1977)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two hands clasped together. The hands are wrapped in detailed sleeves and the sketch is done in pencil on textured paper. The pencil work varies in darkness for contrast. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Studies of a Sled and Various Household Objects
artworks.medium: graphite, pen and black ink, watercolor, and gouache on blue-gray wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of J. William Middendorf, II, 1977)
artworks.description: The image shows a large drawing of a wooden boat with red details at the top. The color palette consists of earthy tones like brown, gray, and muted red against a blue-green paper background. A pair of scissors is depicted diagonally on the left side, and faint sketches of an iron, candlestick, and jug are on the right. The boat is the focal point, with the other objects positioned below, creating a layered composition.

artworks.title: Blankenbergh
artworks.medium: gouache over graphite on blue wove paper laid down to board
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Mrs. Roger H. Plowden, daughter of the artist, 1952)
artworks.description: The image shows a beach scene with two large wooden boats on the sandy shore. The boats have tall masts and one is draped with a net. The horizon can be seen high against the sky, meeting the distant sea. Smaller boats are visible further to the left. The brushstrokes depict the texture of the wood and the translucent net realistically. The color palette includes soft pastels, with pale blue skies and light sandy tones predominating, complemented by earthy browns and reds on the boats.

artworks.title: Proposed Wall Decoration No. 2, Old Corcoran Gallery of Art
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on wove paper mounted to board
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection
artworks.description: The image shows an ornately decorated wall featuring a frieze with various sculptural elements and a painted portrait medallion. Beneath the frieze are name plaques for "PAOLO VERONESE," "TIZIANO VECELLIO," "PIETRO PAUL RUBENS," and "RAFFAELLO D'URBINO." Two framed paintings are displayed on a mauve-colored section of the wall. The upper painting depicts figures in a pinkish natural setting, while the larger bottom painting shows a tranquil landscape with trees and mountains. The color palette includes earthy tones for the figures and terrain, and a blend of greens and blues for the landscape. The wall is decorated in subdued browns and purples, while the frames of the paintings are gold-toned.

artworks.title: Carrie
artworks.medium: pastel on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Mrs. James Parmelee, 1939)
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person in profile, with short dark hair, prominent cheekbones, and full lips. They are wearing a garment with a blue neckline and hints of green around the neck. The background is plain, with slight discoloration or texture. Inscriptions on the right side of the background read "Carrie," "Cunard 1935," and a signature.

artworks.title: Mill Pond at Windsor, Connecticut
artworks.medium: etching in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Mr. S.R. Koehler, Boston, Massachusetts, 1881)
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape view from a slightly elevated point, showcasing a collection of trees and shrubs reflected in calm waters. The brushstrokes provide detailed texture, especially in the foliage. The color palette is monochromatic, featuring black and gray shades accentuating the etching style. Clouds in the sky add depth and contrast to the scene.

artworks.title: Introductions
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, Mary E. Maxwell Fund, 1956)
artworks.description: This image depicts an indoor boxing scene with a referee and two boxers. The referee is standing on the left side of the ring, dressed in a vest, tie, and long-sleeved shirt, raising the arm of the winning boxer. The victorious boxer is on the right side of the ring, wearing boxing shorts, shoes, and gloves, while the defeated boxer sits slumped in the corner. A crowd of spectators is gathered outside the ring, with various individuals showing different levels of engagement with the match.

artworks.title: Desert Sentinels, Apache Trail, Arizona
artworks.medium: etching in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Frank B. Bristow, 1968)

artworks.title: New York State Militia, 1st Division, 9th Regiment, 3rd Brigade
artworks.medium: hand-colored lithograph on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, Mary E. Maxwell Fund, 1958)
artworks.description: The image features a field officer on horseback at the center, surrounded by rows of soldiers in formation, carrying rifles. The officer is wearing a green military uniform with gold epaulettes, white trousers, and black boots. He holds a sword in his right hand. In the background, there is a cityscape with a detailed building and a softly colored sky with clouds.
